subject.title: fix(macos): fresh setup no longer stalls starting gateway

question: Does the existing earlier-head live evidence suffice, or must the three later production lifecycle commits receive a fresh signed macOS run before merge?
rationale: The later commits materially alter failure recovery and probe behavior in an availability-critical first-run path, so accepting proof from an earlier production revision is a maintainer-owned risk decision.

options.title: Require exact-head macOS proof
options.body: Run the signed current head through healthy reuse, stale-port repair, wedged-listener recovery, and changed-request concurrency before landing.

options.title: Accept earlier proof
options.body: Land using the earlier signed run plus focused tests and CI, explicitly accepting that the latest recovery branches lack live exact-head coverage.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head macOS proof
recommendation.body: Run the signed current head through healthy reuse, stale-port repair, wedged-listener recovery, and changed-request concurrency before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and recent macOS Gateway lifecycle review history make this person the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
